contract: A23-81: Quests remote payload { Quests = rows, Book = { Available, Done } }. Done = finished story quests as 'story:<id>', mains newest first then subs newest first, known ids only, at most 60. Available = subs that only wait for a level ({ Id, Kind = 'Sub', Level, Text = 'Title · Opens at Lv N' }, the other requirements checked on a read-only level view) + ready subs not started yet, never hidden / started / done / other faction, lowest level first, at most 10; no main (the chain has no level gate).
limitations: The Q window (tabs, Config.QuestTabs) is game dev 1's client. Today's dailies are not in Done (a claimed daily's row is replaced, only the count is kept). The real publish loop runs in the onboarding / weapon_first suites (their fixtures read the new table payload).
